edits.before: Q-poke through the wave — the hand hurts more than people remember. Farm safely; your real spells arrive next.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours: your Q out-trades his weak solo Q before Voidlings exist. Poke the wave contact freely.

edits.before: E online: the root that defines the lane. Land it and the Q follow-up chunks; miss it and you farm for fourteen seconds.
edits.after: E online and still your window: root his step-up and the Q follow-up chunks before his E-spread shove arrives at 3.

edits.before: E his step-up, passive-pull the root for the chunk + heal, Q the retreat — every landed root is a won trade with a health refund attached.
edits.after: W reaches 5500+ units and slows — dropping it on his retreat path after a root connects extends the trade and grants a Soul Fragment heal on hit.

edits.before: - Malzahar Nether Grasp: matchup-defining — Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Nevermove for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Nether Grasp is 140/110/80s: point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up; spent, you own a two-minute window. - His Q silence is a flat 6s, your E 12s at rank 1 — budget the root for his step-up, never for spacing.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 like the demon is already online — Swain without R is a slow mage with a dream and a root on cooldown.
edits.after: At half HP Malefic Visions plus the 900-range Q silence finish you; post-6 Nether Grasp makes that HP a death sentence.
